commit.message:
docs: reconcile the three-PR merge and log the package.json near-miss [W1-D5] (#25)

main had not moved since Sep 5 while three CI-green PRs stacked up. Merged in
dependency order - #22 boundary, #20 setup, #24 scheduler - so W2-D8-01 is
unblocked before Thursday.

The package.json conflict is the part worth recording. PR #24 and PR #22 each
chained their own test suite onto pnpm test, so taking either side of the
conflict would have silently dropped the other's tests while CI stayed green.
Resolved to run both; main now runs 25 tests, confirmed by running them rather
than by reading the diff. Same shape as the testnet guard that refused
everything - a failure in the safe-looking direction - and a structural hazard
of parallel work rather than anyone's mistake.

Also logs two days of drift readings, both +0.0h, and records the primer
correction: the temporary floor is 720 from live network settings, not the 688
I wrote, which was remaining-at-sampling.
